source_order: 1. DESIGN.md／ADRで「self-host完了」と「external distribution未完成」を分離し、Doctrineと薄い入口の所有境界を決定する。
2. PSH v2を設計し、CLI解決、固定tests、native projections、managed-path migrationを定義する。
3. Adapterとworkflowをclean targetで自己完結させ、wiredを実行可能性まで検査する。
4. GitHub platform設定用のoperator runbook／companionを用意する。
5. 外部repoでCodex・Cursor・Claude Codeそれぞれのfresh-session canaryを実行する。
6. 他OrganizationでIssue→PR→repair→merge、upgrade、rollbackまで証明した後にtag／Releaseを公開する。
finished_state: Another organization can install, repair, verify, and merge through the real runtime.
acceptance_condition: A clean external consumer completes the live E2E path.

attachment_points.name: consumer-workflow
attachment_points.oracle: the live exact-head check invokes the consumer adapter

milestones.description: Update DESIGN.md and an ADR to separate self-host completion from external distribution and decide Doctrine and thin-entry ownership boundaries.
Design PSH v2, including CLI resolution, fixed tests, native projections, and managed-path migration.
Make the adapter and workflow self-contained and verify execution in a clean target.
